items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: What can a finite molecular investigation establish about interactions of M3 with the chemical environments present in PM6 and BTP-eC9? Develop a physically supported account and determine how far the chosen models can represent those material components.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. Any conclusion applies to explicitly defined finite models. Molecular attraction, electrostatic descriptors or one optimized contact cannot establish film morphology, exciton dissociation, charge transport or photovoltaic efficiency, nor a universal PM6/BTP-eC9 affinity ordering.
